summary: The proposed patch resolves the issue of pickling a figure with aligned labels by replacing weak references with strong references in the Grouper class.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new class `PicklableGrouper` which is a significant change in the codebase. It may not align with the existing conventions and could lead to confusion for future maintainers.
The code could benefit from additional comments explaining the purpose of the `PicklableGrouper` class and why it is necessary to use strong references instead of weak references.
